metaTitle: AI study buddy for students on Mac
description: An AI study buddy for students on Mac: hold a key to get the diagram on screen explained, turn notes into lists, and keep deadlines as reminders, in any app.
intro: Lazur is an AI study buddy for students on the Mac. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask it to explain the diagram or paragraph on your screen in plain words, or to set the reminder for your essay. It works in any app.
tldr: “Explain this diagram simply” with your lecture slides open.
“Remind me the essay is due Friday” goes straight into Reminders.
Dictate notes with fn in Google Docs, Notion or Word.
Use it to understand the work, and follow your school's rules on AI.

Lazur is good at explaining what is in front of you. Use it to understand your readings and get unstuck in apps. Your school sets the rules for AI in assignments, so check them.

faq.question: Is there a student discount?
faq.answer: Check the [pricing page](/pricing) for current offers.

faq.question: Does Lazur work in every app?
faq.answer: Yes. It works on top of any Mac app: Mail, Slack, Chrome, Word, Figma, Cursor and the rest.

faq.question: Is it always listening?
faq.answer: No. It listens and looks at your screen only while you hold the shortcut. Audio and the screenshot are not stored.
